name: ElectroGen
tagline: Turn a text brief into a buildable electronics blueprint
description: ElectroGen turns a plain-language idea into a buildable electronics project: component BOM with real marketplace parts, wiring, firmware, engineering checks, and prototype renders for Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi and generic platforms. This remote server exposes five read-only tools: describe_platform, get_capabilities, list_public_projects (community blueprint gallery), get_component_products (component marketplace), and list_news_posts. No authentication required.
